lessons.title: Choose the Project Generator and Build Baseline

questions.title: Start from Spring Initializr
questions.question: Spring Initializr creates a Spring Boot project shell and lets us choose the build system, language, Java version, metadata, and dependencies before source files are generated. Which generator should we use to begin the PetClinic reconstruction?

questions.title: Choose Maven first
questions.question: PetClinic supports Maven and Gradle, but pom.xml is a primary build definition and gives us the first reproducible build path. Which build system should we select first?

questions.title: Choose Java
questions.question: Spring PetClinic is implemented in Java. Spring Initializr can generate Java, Kotlin, or Groovy projects. Which language should we select for this reconstruction?

questions.title: Use Java 17 as the baseline
questions.question: The canonical PetClinic project declares Java 17 as its baseline. Which Java version should we select so the generated project matches that build requirement?

questions.title: Set the PetClinic group
questions.question: Maven coordinates identify a project with a group and artifact. PetClinic source code lives under org.springframework.samples.petclinic, so which group value should we use before defining the artifact?

questions.title: Set the PetClinic artifact and package
questions.question: The project repository is named spring-petclinic, while the Java base package is org.springframework.samples.petclinic. Which artifact name should we enter now so the generated project carries the PetClinic project identity?

questions.title: Add Spring Web
questions.question: PetClinic is a server-rendered Spring MVC application. Spring Web provides the MVC request-handling infrastructure used by controllers and the embedded web application. Which dependency should we add first for the web layer?

questions.title: Add Spring Data JPA
questions.question: PetClinic persists owners, pets, visits, and veterinarians in relational databases. Spring Data JPA provides repository abstractions on top of JPA and Hibernate. Which dependency should we add for persistence?

questions.title: Add Validation
questions.question: PetClinic validates form data such as names, dates, and other domain inputs before accepting changes. Spring Boot's Validation dependency integrates Jakarta Bean Validation for these rules. Which dependency should we add?

questions.title: Set the project name to petclinic
questions.question: Maven uses the artifact ID for coordinates, but the project can also have a human-readable name. The canonical PetClinic pom.xml declares <name>petclinic</name>. Which project name should we enter so the generated project identity matches the finished application?

questions.title: Correct the Java base package
questions.question: Spring Boot component scanning normally starts from the package containing the application class. The canonical PetClinic Java source lives under org.springframework.samples.petclinic, so which package name should we set instead of the artifact-derived org.springframework.samples.springpetclinic?

questions.title: Keep JAR packaging
questions.question: Spring Boot can package an application as a JAR or WAR. PetClinic runs as a self-contained Spring Boot application with an embedded web server rather than being deployed as a traditional external-container WAR. Which packaging option should we keep selected?

questions.title: Use Properties configuration
questions.question: Spring Boot supports both .properties and YAML configuration. The canonical PetClinic repository uses application.properties together with profile-specific .properties files under src/main/resources. Which configuration format should the generated project use?
